newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Jan foreign investment approvals $5.2bln.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Jan foreign investment approvals $5.2bln.

text.p: Indonesia approved foreign investment proposals worth $5.2 billion in January 1997, Investment Minister Sanyoto Sastrowardoyo said on Wednesday.

"We approved 80 new foreign direct investment projects worth $5.2 billion in January," Sastrowardoyo revealed at a seminar on trades and investments organised by the United Nations Economic and Social Council for Asia-Pacific (ESCAP) and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN).
Foreign investment approvals in January 1996 totalled about $3.9 billion.
Sastrowardoyo said foreign investment approvals for the calendar 1996 amounted to 959 projects worth $29.9 billion.
Indonesia posted its highest level of foreign investment approvals of $39.9 billion in 1995 against $23.7 billion in 1994.
